summary: Tested encryption-at-rest for integrations, user activity log isolation, admin search-by-user (Monitoring), Downloads page, and login regression for all 4 seed accounts. Backend pytest 14/14 passed. Frontend flows all verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1700 lines - splitting into modules (auth, integrations, admin, activity) is overdue.
ENCRYPTION_KEY is read at module import (`os.environ[...]` without default) - good fail-fast, but consider logging a startup-time confirmation that encryption is active.

Fernet decrypt in list_integrations happens per row - fine at current scale, but if a stored ciphertext is corrupted, decrypt_config raises InvalidToken and the entire GET /api/integrations 500s; consider wrapping per-field with try/except and marking the field as unrecoverable.
GET /api/admin/users/{id}/activity has no pagination/limit param beyond the hard-coded 300 - acceptable for now, revisit if activity_log grows.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ n8n and s3 integrations for demo user; created and deleted a TEST note for alice. No residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_encryption_activity_admin.py directly inspect Mongo to verify Fernet ciphertext (gAAAAA prefix). httpbin.org/post used as N8N target. Admin search-by-user uses /admin/users then /admin/users/{id}/activity; testids: user-activity-search, user-search-result, drilldown-logs, clear-user-selection. Downloads page testids: download-{windows,macos,linux}.

verification_details.encryption: raw 'config' absent from all API responses (create, list, admin); secret fields (api_key/token/access_key/secret_key/access_token/password) rendered as bullets in config_masked; non-secret fields (region/bucket/provider/model) cleartext; Mongo integrations.config.token stored as Fernet ciphertext starting 'gAAAAA' - direct DB inspection confirmed. N8N /run to httpbin.org/post returned status=200 (decrypt path works). S3 /files with bad creds returned 400 (graceful).
verification_details.activity_isolation: GET /api/activity/me returns only entries where user_id == caller (verified for alice and bob). Alice created a note via API -> 'Created a note' appeared as top row on /activity page (112 rows total).
verification_details.admin_search: Search 'alice' returned 1 result; clicking loaded 112 drilldown-logs entries; 'Back to search' cleared selection.
verification_details.downloads: /downloads renders all 3 platform cards + build-instructions; no console errors.
verification_details.regression: All 4 accounts login OK; integrations catalog still returns 6 connectors.
